item.description: AMD says CEO Lisa Su backed relaunching the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, a plan made before the DDR5 memory market changes, according to a director.

item.description: Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois will miss the LaLiga match at Barcelona on Sunday due to flu, the club said.

item.title: Newlands to provide test of more than bat and ball for Australia
item.description: Australia face South Africa in the series-deciding third Test at Newlands, where Steve Smith returns to a venue tied to the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal.

item.description: A head-to-head test compares portrait camera modes on the iPhone, Pixel 11 Pro XL and Galaxy S26 Plus.

item.description: A review marks two years since the Google TV Streamer's 2024 launch and asks whether it is still worth buying.

item.title: Nvidia eyes converting old nuclear plants into massive AI data centers
item.description: Nvidia and German energy firm PreussenElektra are studying whether decommissioned German nuclear power plant sites can be converted into AI data centers.

item.title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Nvidia has open-sourced Flora, a data engine that labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents, versus $88 with GPT-6 Astra.

item.title: Cybersecurity bounty hunter says Samsung TVs use AI to record audio and screenshots for ads
item.description: A cybersecurity researcher who reverse-engineered a Samsung TV says the Tizen system can collect telemetry, audio and screenshots to improve targeted ads. The researcher said background programs processing this data may cause sluggish performance. Why it matters: Raises privacy concerns about smart TVs collecting audio and screen data for ad targeting.

item.title: Relax at ‘Gardens by the Bay’ before surgery at KKH: Virtual reality helps to calm patients
item.description: KK Women's and Children's Hospital's immersive VR program helped reduce patients' pre-surgery anxiety by about 30% and is offered at no cost for gynaecological operations.

item.title: Dlh Holdings director Mink Brook Asset Management buys $208 stock
SoftBank’s Son plans US$50 billion Malaysia tech outlay: Anwar Ibrahim
item.description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son plans to invest US$50 billion in Malaysia, covering AI, emerging technologies and data centers. The locations named were Sarawak, Kuching and the Malaysian Peninsula. Why it matters: Large foreign AI and data center investment in Southeast Asia, expanding SoftBank's regional reach.

item.title: Goldman cuts Kospi 12-month target by 25% as AI trade unravels
item.description: Goldman Sachs cut its 12-month Kospi target by 25% to 9,000 from 12,000, citing more conservative valuation assumptions after the index fell over 35% from its June peak. The revised target implies more than 60% upside. Why it matters: Shows shifting sentiment on AI stocks, with Samsung and SK Hynix central to the Kospi.

item.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
item.description: Anthropic recommends companies evaluate consolidating many subagents into one agent that loads context on demand.

item.description: Town's CEO says most people don't yet use AI agents for tasks, and Town wants to make AI practical for small businesses.

item.title: SGX’s new ETFs offer Asia, global exposure, but broad baskets can hide risk
item.description: New ETFs listed on the Singapore Exchange offer Asian and global market exposure, but experts say investors should watch fees, currency risk and concentration.

item.title: lordon1a/agents.md: A drop-in AGENTS.md system prompt for coding agents: full execution, no hedging, no moralizing, no…
item.description: A drop-in AGENTS.md system prompt for coding agents, a single 14 KB file meant to stop hedging, moralizing, fading to black and asking permission for requested work. It is written as a constitution rather than a task list. Why it matters: Shows interest in instruction files that change how coding agents behave; it has 66 GitHub stars so far.
